lcWGS panel of 6204 haplotypes (< 30311): conditioning capped in GLIMPSE2 rank order (g2) at kpbwt 2000, no
rare-carrier augmentation, 2 Gibbs chain(s) of 20 iterations (15 main) averaged; LCWGS_SMALL_PANEL=old restores
chunked Gibbs: 82.4 cM span → 6 chunks (core 16.0 cM + 0.5 cM buffer each side)
lcWGS sample waves: RSS target 13.47 GB, reclaim above 10.10 GB (shared/cache 3.05 GB)
chunk parallelism: 6 live, up to 16 sample tasks (budget 61.6 GB, estimated 21.68 GB)
